title: Data for the native cyclic derived Hom sequence
statement: Let C be a Grothendieck abelian category, F an additive autoequivalence, and choose ordinary derived localizations for C and its fixed-pair category B as in [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write U for derived forgetting and θ:UF≅U for the localized structure. Define V^r(M,N)=Hom(UM,UN[r]) with action T(u)=θ_N[r] D(F)(u) θ_M^{-1}, defect 1-T, invariants ker(1-T) in degree zero, coinvariants coker(1-T) in degree minus one, and the forgetting homomorphism. A boundary family is an additive map from these coinvariants to Hom_B(M,N) for bounded M,N. Exactness, native morphism naturality and normalization by the canonical connecting map of an underlying split off-diagonal extension are the predicates of the parent node. Transport along J,H with a shift comparison and forgetting comparison is conjugation by the comparison and the H-image of u. Package its additivity, T-compatibility, forgetting and boundary squares in the functoriality predicate. Define the exact and uniquely unit-normalized right-derived forgetting comparisons using [lem-sf-fixed-pair-derived-forget-comparison, def-sfb-right-derived-functor], and the setting, transport and Generated finite-composite data. This module relocates the existing definitions verbatim, without introducing a second version of any notion.
